# AudioPlayground - audio P1 consumer proof: an ambient Music-bus loop + four pitched 3D
# emitters (components, autoplay, listener-on-camera) + click-to-fire positional
# one-shots, demonstrating attenuation/pan/pitch/doppler on the miniaudio-backed
# subsystem. The tiny WAV assets are generated by Data/generate_audio.py (committed).
add_executable(AudioPlayground main.cpp)

target_link_libraries(AudioPlayground PRIVATE
    Draconic::Core
    Draconic::Runtime
    Draconic::RuntimeClient
    Draconic::ShellDesktop Draconic::RuntimeDesktop
    Draconic::Graphics
    Draconic::GraphicsGpu
    Draconic::RuntimeDefaultApp
    Draconic::Scene
    Draconic::SceneSubsystem
    Draconic::RenderSubsystem
    Draconic::Audio Draconic::AudioSubsystem
    Draconic::Imgui
    Draconic::Policy)
draconic_copy_sdl3_dll(AudioPlayground)

target_compile_definitions(AudioPlayground PRIVATE
    DRACONIC_AUDIO_SAMPLE_DATA_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Data")
